title: Effectiveness of Age-assurance Requirements for Social Media Services
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Age-assurance Requirements for Social Media Services

sections.label: Social media platform negotiations ongoing
sections.summary: Negotiations with social media platforms continue, with broad requirements from app distribution services and existing technologies for age assurance and personal data protection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The discussions and negotiations with the social media platforms are still ongoing, and we would have to provide information at the later date when ready.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But what I can inform the Member is this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have actually done so with the Code of Practice for Online Safety for the apps distribution services and so, we have an idea of how to go about doing this, and we do see already there are existing mature technologies that they can already apply and use.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will use our same broad requirements for the app distribution services while we are negotiating for the requirements for the designated social media services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We note the Member had mentioned also concerns on personal data for example, there are already currently technologies that will be able to actually effectively manage age assurance measures, but also take into account data protection of personal data for everyone, but in particular for children.

sections.label: Ministers met young people
sections.summary: The Minister and the speaker met many young people to understand their views on age assurance measures and social media platforms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The Minister and myself have met many young people as part of our efforts to actually understand their perspectives on how we should introduce the age assurance measures and the approach we should take, with regard to the social media platforms.

sections.label: Youths support tiered approach
sections.summary: Young people agree some measures are needed, support the tiered approach, and prefer a calibrated approach without being totally cut out.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: They do agree that there needs to be some sort of measures in place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But what they hope and what they prefer to have is not to be totally cut out.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, they are generally supportive of our tiered approach, but they do wish for us to have a calibrated approach to this.

sections.label: Approach for Singapore youths
sections.summary: These efforts will help form a meaningful approach for youths in Singapore, and more information will be provided when available.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: All these will be helping us in actually forming a meaningful approach for our youths here in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, these are all still in the works and we will provide more information when available.
